verdict.rationale: Smithery's documented Triggers let an MCP server surface upstream events, which the server POSTs directly to the consumer. That is an event-subscription building block. There is no documented way for a user to define rules that automatically run actions when those events fire; the consumer would have to build that logic. The shutdown notice also says the hosted Connect services through which triggers are activated stopped working on October 31, 2026.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
